digest.component_or_area: plan-review verdict dispatch and criteria assembly
propositions: Criteria assembly raises CriteriaError when loading repository criteria overlay, but the generic workflow recorder preserves only an undifferentiated string, losing typed failure identity.
Gate dispatch routes every unrecovered workflow failure through _degraded_plan_review_verdict, which unconditionally stamps llm_unavailable=true regardless of whether any LLM/batch frame executed.

A stale/malformed criteria configuration must emit a fail-closed INDETERMINATE verdict with a distinct config_fault diagnostic naming the installed rebar build as suspect, not a mislabeled llm_unavailable outage.

Verdict dispatch must inspect the recorded failed assemble step, route only CriteriaError to a dedicated config-fault path before generic LLM degradation, and preserve deterministic coverage/blocker behavior.
Genuine LLMUnavailableError and healthy provider paths must remain byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged after the repair.
